originalText:
CLAUDE FABLE 5 CHANGES THE GAME: FROM PROMPTS TO GOALS.

Until now, AI was a tool you micromanaged.

Prompt → Review → Prompt → Fix → Repeat.

Claude Fable 5 flips that model on its head.

Instead of giving AI step-by-step instructions, you give it a destination.

Then it plans, builds, tests, verifies, and iterates until the goal is complete.

The biggest shift isn't intelligence.

It's autonomy.

One demo built an entire productivity suite:

✅ Task manager
✅ Kanban board
✅ Calendar
✅ Notes app
✅ Pomodoro tracker
✅ Arcade game

...from a single high-level goal.

The new workflow is simple:

Old AI: "Do this next."

New AI: "Here's the outcome. Figure it out."

We're moving from prompting models to managing autonomous systems.

And that changes everything.

originalText:
I gave Fable 5 one prompt and it sent 8 audit agents through 13GB of my second brain.

Every automation and every Claude Code skill I've built since January.

That vault runs my whole business.

Content systems, marketing agents, a production website, scheduled jobs that work while I sleep.

I assumed it was all in good shape, because everything felt like it was working.

Fable 5 graded it a C minus.

It found two automations that had quietly died weeks earlier.

The alert system that was supposed to catch them turned out to be broken as well, and had been for a month.

One job was throwing 1,430 errors every single Sunday without saying a word.

Then it turned the whole mess into a fancy looking HTML fix plan ordered by what kills the business first.

And the whole audit is one prompt.

It works on any Claude Code setup.

Turn your model to Fable 5 and point it at your second brain or the project you've been building, and it will tell you:

>> Which of your automations are silently broken right now (mine had been dead for weeks and looked fine from the outside)
>> Where live API keys are hiding in files you forgot you wrote
>> The one risk almost every solo operator is carrying that can erase everything overnight
>> What to fix first, ranked by what would actually hurt you

If you want the full prompt, comment "AUDIT" and I'll DM it right now (must be following)
